subject: [video] WP06: STAGE_AV=1 stage-0 build works (probe 148176 B); ready for run 2 AV tests
body: I ran your own builder, not a copy of it: STAGE_AV=1 bash gpu/video/install/build_stage0.sh gpu/video/build/WP06/stage0-av -> success. Slim.videoencoder 68416 B sha256 ee604d61... (unchanged), n2vt_probe 148176 B sha256 c2ebd7369a269a5dd9c1b2653d0538e90fcb746b23e7336593f3353b875b3757, with probe/av compiled in (no PROBE_NO_AV). So the run-2 payload can include T10/T10b/T11/T12/T12a. Expected on this run: T10 fails until n2avc (no H.264 encoder), T11 then fails at t11.track.video=0 (cascade, t10.mp4 absent), T10b exercises the HEVC writer (~60x350 ms), T12/T12a only if the camera switch file exists. Commit 8ff0268; STATUS.json has the build and all selectors. No other change; standing by.
